project: Wuxia Life P56 Ordinary Origin Growth Wave
description: Grow the three already-proven ordinary origins beyond P25 minimum acceptance by adding bounded midlife depth, clearer player-facing differentiation, and narrow verification assets, without reopening sample lines, adding a fourth origin, or expanding into a full ordinary-life content system.

userStories.title: Audit ordinary-origin growth gaps
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of what the three ordinary origins already prove and what still feels thin so P56 grows depth rather than replaying P25 acceptance work.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the proven surfaces and thin spots for the three ordinary origins
Separate already-met minimum criteria from growth opportunities
Save docs/test-reports/p56-ordinary-origin-growth-gap-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Lock ordinary growth scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract for ordinary-origin growth so P56 stays focused on depth and differentiation instead of broad world expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit the stage to farm_peasant, town_apprentice, and tavern_hand
Define allowed layers: story configuration, light presentation, validation scripts
List forbidden expansions: fourth origin, sample-line work, full ordinary system, bulk deferred wiring
Save docs/test-reports/p56-ordinary-origin-growth-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define peasant growth contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded growth contract for farm_peasant so the path has a clearer midlife identity beyond early hardship tags.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least two peasant-specific midlife signals or forks
Include at least one signal around staying, switching, or accumulating through hardship
Do not rewrite peasant into a vivid origin
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Define apprentice growth contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded growth contract for town_apprentice so the path leads more clearly toward craft or merchant opportunity instead of only serving as a starter tag.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least two apprentice-specific midlife signals or forks
Include at least one signal around trade, craft, or merchant opportunity
Keep the path ordinary instead of recreating merchant_house
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Define tavern growth contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded growth contract for tavern_hand so the path shows clearer network-driven opportunity rather than only serving as a generic social start.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least two tavern-specific midlife signals or forks
Include at least one signal around ally networks, guests, or chance meetings
Keep the path ordinary instead of turning it into a vivid elite social route
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Wire ordinary growth story configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the three ordinary origins wired with bounded midlife depth so their opportunity structures stay distinct beyond the childhood slice.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the three ordinary paths gets at least one new midlife configuration touchpoint
Do not introduce a new origin framework
Existing early-life wiring and P25 regression evidence do not regress
Relevant targeted tests can verify the additions

userStories.title: Add ordinary player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the three ordinary origins to read differently in summaries, goals, or life-memory so the growth wave feels visible instead of hidden in flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Each origin gets at least one new readable signal on existing surfaces
The wording explains the different opportunity structure of each origin
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Add ordinary mid-tier verification slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded verification slice proving that the added ordinary-origin growth changes are runtime-visible and not just documented intentions.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce at least one mid-tier or midlife ordinary verification artifact
Cover all three ordinary origins in the artifact
Show key flags, events, or summaries in a readable way
Do not require full lifetime exhaust

userStories.title: Add ordinary regression tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests for the ordinary growth additions so later edits do not flatten the three paths back into generic low-tier starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one narrow assert for each of the three ordinary origins
Reuse existing P25, origin, or simulation harnesses
Do not rewrite all P25 tests
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P56 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a P56 closure report showing what ordinary-origin depth increased and what still remains out of scope for a larger ordinary-content wave.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p56-ordinary-origin-growth-closure-report.md
Summarize configuration, expression, verification, and test evidence
Confirm that the P25 Wave 4 minimum remains valid and unchanged
List deferred ordinary-content expansion items
